xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnComposition: 1. The provisions for constitution of the Risk Management Committee is not applicable to the Company during the period under review since, the Company does not fall under the category of top 1000 listed entities as per the market capitalization of the previous financial year. 2. During the period under review, the Company did not have any Independent Director. 3. The provision regarding composition of the Audit Committee, Nomination and Remuneration Committee, Stakeholders Relationship Committee and Corporate Social Responsibility Committee could not be complied due to absence of Independent Directors on the Board.The Company being a Government Company composition of directors is not within its control.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnMeetingOfBo: 1. The Company had no Independent Directors during quarter ended on December 31, 2025. The Company receives direction from Administrative Ministry regarding the appointment of Directors on the Board, which is still awaited. 2. At the Board Meetings dated 13th August, 2025 and 11th November, 2025 the requirement of presence of minimum 1 Independent Director as per Regulation 17(2A) of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 could not be met, since the Company had no Independent Director on its Board. 3.At the Board Meeting held on 11th November, 2025, the quorum requirement of a minimum of three Directors, as stipulated under Regulation 17(2A) of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, was not met owing to the absence of Shri Arvind Nath Jha, Government Nominee Director. 4. The other requirements like time gap between two Meetings were met with.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnMeetingOfCo: Being a Government Company, the appointment of Directors on the Board is not within control of the Company. At the meetings dated 13-08-2025 and 11-11-2025 of the Audit Committee , the requirement of quorum could not be met with due to absence of Independent Directors on the Board of the Company. The other requirements like time gap between two Meetings were met with.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesToAnnexure1Ex:
1. During the period under review, the Company did not have any Independent Director on its Board. 2. During the period under review, the Company did not have a Woman Director. 3. During the period under review, the Board of Directors did not comprise of minimum 6 Directors. 4.The other requirements like time gap between two Meetings were met with. 5. Due to absence of Independent Directors the following requirements of SEBI (LODR) were not fulfilled- i.the composition of Audit Committee, NRC and SRC are not in compliance with the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 ii.the composition of CSR Committee is not in compliance with the Companies Act, 2013 iii.the requirement of quorum could not be met for Board Meeting, Audit Committee Meeting.
However, the Company being a Government Company, the composition of the BOD is not within the control of the Company. The direction of the Administrative Ministry is awaited.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: Fines amounting to Rs. 9,88,840 (inclusive of GST) as per SEBI Master Circular No. SEBI/HO/CFD/PoD2/CIR/P/0155 dated November 11, 2024 (Chapter-Vll(A)-Penal Actions for Non-Compliance).
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: Non-compliance of Regulation 17(1), 17(2A), 18(1) and 19(1)/ 19(2) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 for the quarter ended 31st December, 2025.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: No immediate impact is expected except a contingent liability of Rs.9,88,840/- (inclusive of GST) may be created against imposition of the said fine.
